description: This file implements the RuntimeManagerHandler class for managing application runtime states, including initialization, control commands (start, kill, suspend, resume, etc.), and event notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerHandler
classes.description: Handles runtime management operations such as starting, stopping, suspending, resuming, and event notification for applications within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class that receives notifications from the RuntimeManager about application lifecycle events like start, terminate, failure, and state changes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the runtime manager by querying the RuntimeManager interface and registering for notifications.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Unregisters from notifications and releases the RuntimeManager interface.

methods.name: getRuntimeStats
methods.description: Retrieves runtime information for a specific application instance.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts an application with specified parameters and environment variables.

methods.name: wake
methods.description: Wakes up an application from suspended or paused state.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Dispatches runtime events to the registered event handler.
